proposals.title: Proposal 6
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent Board Chair or lead director structure; the proposal text is not fully reproduced in the section, only the Board's opposition is shown.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Increase Diversity of Director Nominees
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the initial list of director candidates to include non-management employees, similar to the Rooney Rule.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Lobbying disclosure report
proposals.proponent: Miller/Howard Investments, Inc. on behalf of Luc Theeuwes and the Greater Manchester Pension Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, and board oversight of lobbying and grassroots communications.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Racial equity audit
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a racial equity audit analyzing Citi's adverse impacts on nonwhite stakeholders and communities of color, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9.

proposals.title: Public Benefit Corporation conversion
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board approve amending the certificate of incorporation to become a Public Benefit Corporation and submit it to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 10.
